examples.translation: If this space were free, I would put my desk there.

examples.sentence: L'espace public a été aménagé pour les piétons.
examples.translation: Public space was arranged for pedestrians.

entries.intro: A comfortable padded seat with armrests (armchair). Related to 'chaise' (Chunk 2) and 'lit' (Chunk 3).
entries.usage: Masculine noun. Plural: fauteuils. Pronunciation: ending -euil is pronounced /œj/.

examples.sentence: Je m'assois dans le fauteuil du salon.
examples.translation: I sit down in the living room armchair.

examples.sentence: Ce fauteuil en cuir est très confortable.
examples.translation: This leather armchair is very comfortable.

examples.sentence: Si le fauteuil était libre, je m'y installerais.
examples.translation: If the armchair were free, I would settle in it.

examples.sentence: Le fauteuil a été déplacé près de la fenêtre.
examples.translation: The armchair was moved near the window.

entries.intro: A physical key to lock/unlock, or a key solution/factor. Related to 'porte' (Chunk 3).
entries.usage: Feminine noun. Plural: clés. Can also be spelled 'clef' (plural: clefs, f is silent).

examples.sentence: Je cherche la clé de ma voiture.
examples.translation: I am looking for my car key.

examples.sentence: La clé du problème est la patience.
examples.translation: The key to the problem is patience. (Abstract)

examples.sentence: Si j'avais la clé, j'ouvrirais la porte.
examples.translation: If I had the key, I would open the door.

examples.sentence: La clé a été perdue dans le jardin.
examples.translation: The key was lost in the garden.

entries.intro: A wall of a building/room, or a barrier. Related to 'fenêtre' and 'porte'.
entries.usage: Masculine noun. Plural: murs. Spelling note: do not confuse with 'mûr' (ripe).

examples.sentence: Il peint le mur en blanc.
examples.translation: He is painting the wall white.

examples.sentence: Le mur de cette maison est très épais.
examples.translation: The wall of this house is very thick.

examples.sentence: Si le mur tombait, la maison s'effondrerait.
examples.translation: If the wall fell, the house would collapse.

examples.sentence: Le mur a été construit par les ouvriers.
examples.translation: The wall was built by the workers.

entries.intro: A meal (breakfast, lunch, dinner). Related to 'cuisine' (kitchen) and 'pain' (bread).
entries.usage: Masculine noun. Ending in -s, spelling remains identical in singular and plural (le repas / les repas). Final -s is silent.

examples.sentence: Nous prenons trois repas par jour.
examples.translation: We take three meals per day.

examples.sentence: Le repas est délicieux ce soir.
examples.translation: The meal is delicious tonight.

examples.sentence: Si le repas était froid, je le réchaufferais.
examples.translation: If the meal were cold, I would warm it up.

examples.sentence: Le repas a été préparé par le chef.
examples.translation: The meal was prepared by the chef.

entries.intro: The room in a house containing a bath or shower. Cross-referenced with 'salle' (Chunk 3).
entries.usage: Feminine compound noun. Plural: salles de bain or salles de bains.

examples.sentence: La salle de bain est à l'étage.
examples.translation: The bathroom is upstairs.

examples.sentence: Il nettoie la salle de bain ce matin.
examples.translation: He is cleaning the bathroom this morning.

examples.sentence: Si la salle de bain était occupée, j'attendrais.
examples.translation: If the bathroom were occupied, I would wait.

examples.sentence: La salle de bain a été rénovée le mois dernier.
examples.translation: The bathroom was renovated last month.

entries.intro: A public park or playground. Related to 'jardin' (Chunk 3) and 'arbre' (Chunk 3).
entries.usage: Masculine noun. Plural: parcs. Final -c is pronounced /k/.

examples.sentence: Les enfants jouent dans le parc.
examples.translation: The children are playing in the park.

examples.sentence: Nous nous promenons dans le parc.
examples.translation: We are walking in the park.

examples.sentence: Si le parc était fermé, nous irions ailleurs.
examples.translation: If the park were closed, we would go elsewhere.

examples.sentence: Le parc national est protégé par la loi.
examples.translation: The national park is protected by law. (Derived passive context)

entries.translation: plant / sole of foot / to plant (verb root)
entries.intro: Acts as a feminine noun meaning a plant or sole of the foot, or the verb root of 'planter' (to plant).
entries.usage: Feminine noun. Plural: plantes. Verb root is from 'planter'.

examples.sentence: Cette plante a besoin d'eau.
examples.translation: This plant needs water. (Noun usage)

examples.sentence: Il a mal à la plante des pieds.
examples.translation: His soles of his feet hurt. (Noun usage)

examples.sentence: Si tu plantais des fleurs, le jardin serait beau.
examples.translation: If you planted flowers, the garden would be beautiful. (Verb usage)

examples.sentence: La graine est plantée dans le pot.
examples.translation: The seed is planted in the pot. (Verb 'planter' passive)

entries.intro: A large area covered with trees. Related to 'arbre' (Chunk 3) and 'parc' (#345).
entries.usage: Feminine noun. Plural: forêts. Accent circonflexe on 'e'.

examples.sentence: Nous marchons dans la forêt.
examples.translation: We are walking in the forest.

examples.sentence: Il y a beaucoup d'animaux sauvages dans cette forêt.
examples.translation: There are many wild animals in this forest.

examples.sentence: Si la forêt brûlait, ce serait un désastre.
examples.translation: If the forest burned, it would be a disaster.

examples.sentence: La forêt est gérée par l'État.
examples.translation: The forest is managed by the state.

entries.intro: The visual scenery or view of a countryside/nature. Related to 'pays' (country) and 'forêt' (#347).
entries.usage: Masculine noun. Plural: paysages. Placed after 'beau' or qualifiers.

examples.sentence: Je regarde le magnifique paysage par la fenêtre.
examples.translation: I look at the magnificent scenery out the window.

examples.sentence: Ce paysage de montagne est impressionnant.
examples.translation: This mountain scenery is impressive.

examples.sentence: Si le paysage était beau, je prendrais une photo.
examples.translation: If the scenery were beautiful, I would take a photo.

examples.sentence: Ce beau paysage a été peint par l'artiste.
examples.translation: This beautiful landscape was painted by the artist.

entries.intro: A travel/entry ticket, banknote (paper money), or a short written note.
entries.usage: Masculine noun. Plural: billets. Final -t is silent. 'Billet de train' (train ticket), 'billet de banque' (banknote).

examples.sentence: J'achète un billet de train pour Paris.
examples.translation: I am buying a train ticket for Paris.

examples.sentence: Il me donne un billet de dix euros.
examples.translation: He gives me a ten-euro banknote.

examples.sentence: Si j'avais un billet gratuit, j'irais au cinéma.
examples.translation: If I had a free ticket, I would go to the cinema.

examples.sentence: Le billet de concert a été acheté en ligne.
examples.translation: The concert ticket was bought online.

entries.intro: A suitcase/trunk (luggage) for traveling, or background knowledge (intellectual baggage). Related to 'valise' (Chunk 3).
entries.usage: Masculine noun. Plural: bagages (often used in plural 'les bagages' to mean all luggage).

examples.sentence: Je range mon bagage dans le coffre.
examples.translation: I put away my luggage in the trunk.

examples.sentence: Nous voyageons avec peu de bagages.
examples.translation: We travel with little luggage. (Plural usage)

examples.sentence: Si ton bagage était trop lourd, tu paierais un supplément.
examples.translation: If your luggage were too heavy, you would pay extra.

examples.sentence: Le bagage cabine a été vérifié par la sécurité.
examples.translation: The cabin luggage was checked by security.

entries.translation: station (train) / watch out / to park (verb root)
entries.intro: Acts as a feminine noun meaning 'train station', a particle warning 'gare !' (watch out!), or verb form meaning 'to park' (garer).
entries.usage: Feminine noun: la gare, plural: gares. Verb root from 'garer' (to park).

examples.sentence: Le train arrive à la gare.
examples.translation: The train arrives at the station. (Noun usage)

examples.sentence: Gare à toi si tu triches !
examples.translation: Watch out if you cheat! (Particle warning usage)

examples.sentence: Si tu garais la voiture ici, tu aurais une amende.
examples.translation: If you parked the car here, you would have a fine. (Verb 'garer' usage)

examples.sentence: La voiture est garée dans la rue.
examples.translation: The car is parked in the street. (Verb 'garer' passive)

entries.intro: An airfield/airport for commercial aviation. Related to 'avion' (Chunk 3) and 'port' (#353).
entries.usage: Masculine noun. Plural: aéroports. Requires 'l'' (l'aéroport) and liaison in plural.

examples.sentence: Je vais à l'aéroport en taxi.
examples.translation: I am going to the airport by taxi.

examples.sentence: L'aéroport est situé en dehors de la ville.
examples.translation: The airport is situated outside the city.

examples.sentence: Si l'aéroport était fermé, le vol serait annulé.
examples.translation: If the airport were closed, the flight would be cancelled. (Liaison)

examples.sentence: Le nouvel aéroport a été construit l'année dernière.
examples.translation: The new airport was built last year.

entries.intro: A harbor/port for ships, or the carriage/delivery fee (e.g. frais de port), or wearing of clothes/items.
entries.usage: Masculine noun. Plural: ports. Final -t is silent. Related to 'bateau' (Chunk 3) and verb 'porter' (Chunk 2).

examples.sentence: Le bateau est amarré dans le port.
examples.translation: The boat is moored in the harbor.

examples.sentence: Le port de la ceinture est obligatoire.
examples.translation: Wearing a seatbelt is mandatory. (Wearing usage)

examples.sentence: Si le port était bloqué, les navires attendraient dehors.
examples.translation: If the port were blocked, the ships would wait outside.

examples.sentence: Le colis a été envoyé port payé. (Carriage fee context)
examples.translation: The package was sent carriage paid.

entries.intro: An outer garment (coat/overcoat) worn for warmth. Related to 'vêtement' (Chunk 3) and 'pantalon' (#355).
entries.usage: Masculine noun. Plural: manteaux.

examples.sentence: Il met son manteau avant de sortir.
examples.translation: He puts on his coat before going out.

examples.sentence: Elle a acheté un manteau de laine chaud.
examples.translation: She bought a warm wool coat.

examples.sentence: Si l'hiver était froid, je porterais un long manteau.
examples.translation: If the winter were cold, I would wear a long coat. (Liaison)

examples.sentence: Le manteau a été lavé au pressing.
examples.translation: The coat was washed at the dry cleaner's.

entries.intro: An article of clothing covering the body from waist to ankles. Related to 'vêtement' (Chunk 3) and 'robe' (#356).
entries.usage: Masculine noun. Plural: pantalons. Always singular in French when referring to one piece of clothing (un pantalon), unlike English 'pants'.

examples.sentence: Je porte un pantalon bleu aujourd'hui.
examples.translation: I am wearing blue pants today.

examples.sentence: Ce pantalon est trop long pour moi.
examples.translation: These pants are too long for me.

examples.sentence: Si tu mettais ce pantalon, tu serais élégant.
examples.translation: If you put on these pants, you would look elegant.

examples.sentence: Le pantalon a été repassé par ma mère.
examples.translation: The pants were ironed by my mother.

entries.intro: A one-piece garment for women (dress), or the coat color of a horse/dog. Related to 'vêtement' (Chunk 3) and 'pantalon' (#355).
entries.usage: Feminine noun. Plural: robes.

examples.sentence: Elle porte une belle robe rouge.
examples.translation: She is wearing a beautiful red dress.

examples.sentence: La mariée a une robe blanche.
examples.translation: The bride has a white gown.

examples.sentence: Si la robe était à ma taille, je l'achèterais.
examples.translation: If the dress were my size, I would buy it.

examples.sentence: La robe a été cousue par la couturière.
examples.translation: The dress was sewn by the dressmaker.

entries.intro: A pocket in a garment, or a small plastic pouch/bag. Related to 'manteau' (#354) and 'sac' (Chunk 3).
entries.usage: Feminine noun. Plural: poches. 'Livre de poche' (paperback book).

examples.sentence: J'ai les clés dans ma poche.
examples.translation: I have the keys in my pocket.

examples.sentence: Il met ses mains dans ses poches.
examples.translation: He puts his hands in his pockets.

examples.sentence: Si ma poche était trouée, je perdrais mes pièces.
examples.translation: If my pocket had a hole, I would lose my coins.

examples.sentence: L'argent a été glissé dans sa poche.
examples.translation: The money was slipped into his/her pocket.

entries.intro: Butter, dairy product. Related to 'pain' (bread) and 'fromage' (#359).
entries.usage: Masculine noun. Uncountable. Plural: beurres (rare). 'Tartine de beurre' (bread with butter).

examples.sentence: Je mets du beurre sur mon pain.
examples.translation: I put butter on my bread.

examples.sentence: Le beurre est dans le réfrigérateur.
examples.translation: The butter is in the refrigerator.

examples.sentence: Si le beurre était fondu, nous l'utiliserions pour la pâte.
examples.translation: If the butter were melted, we would use it for the batter.

examples.sentence: Le beurre a été acheté au supermarché.
examples.translation: The butter was bought at the supermarket.

entries.intro: Cheese, dairy product. Related to 'beurre' (#358) and 'lait' (Chunk 3).
entries.usage: Masculine noun. Plural: fromages. 'Plateau de fromages' (cheese board).

examples.sentence: La France est célèbre pour son fromage.
examples.translation: France is famous for its cheese.

examples.sentence: Je préfère le fromage de chèvre.
examples.translation: I prefer goat cheese.

examples.sentence: Si le fromage était trop fort, je n'en mangerais pas.
examples.translation: If the cheese were too strong, I wouldn't eat any.

examples.sentence: Le fromage est servi après le plat principal.
examples.translation: Cheese is served after the main course.

entries.intro: Acts as a feminine noun meaning 'beer' (alcoholic drink) or historically 'coffin' (bier). Related to 'vin' (Chunk 3).
entries.usage: Feminine noun. Plural: bières. 'Chopes de bière' (beer mugs).

examples.sentence: Il boit une bière fraîche au pub.
examples.translation: He is drinking a cold beer at the pub.

examples.sentence: La bière belge est très réputée.
examples.translation: Belgian beer is very famous.

examples.sentence: Si la bière était chaude, elle serait mauvaise.
examples.translation: If the beer were warm, it would taste bad.

examples.sentence: La bière a été brassée selon la tradition.
examples.translation: The beer was brewed according to tradition.

entries.intro: Expresses certainty (sure), or refers to unidentified items (some/certain people).
entries.usage: Inflects: certain (m), certaine (f), certains (m pl), certaines (f pl). Precedes the noun when meaning 'some'.

examples.sentence: Je suis certain de ma réponse.
examples.translation: I am sure of my answer.

examples.sentence: Certains étudiants sont absents aujourd'hui.
examples.translation: Some students are absent today. (Pronoun/adjective)

examples.sentence: Si le résultat était certain, je n'aurais pas peur.
examples.translation: If the result were sure, I wouldn't be afraid. (Liaison)

examples.sentence: Un succès certain a été promis par le chef.
examples.translation: A certain success was promised by the boss.

entries.intro: Refers to something that can happen. Opposite of 'impossible' (#363).
entries.usage: Inflects: possible (m/f), possibles (pl). 'Si possible' (if possible).

examples.sentence: Il est possible de venir demain.
examples.translation: It is possible to come tomorrow. (Impersonal)

examples.sentence: Trouvez une solution possible.
examples.translation: Find a possible solution.

examples.sentence: Si cela était possible, je le ferais tout de suite.
examples.translation: If that were possible, I would do it immediately.

examples.sentence: Cet objectif a été rendu possible par vos efforts.
examples.translation: This goal was made possible by your efforts.

entries.intro: Refers to something that cannot happen. Opposite of 'possible' (#362).
entries.usage: Inflects: impossible (m/f), impossibles (pl). Requires prefix 'im-'. Requires 'l'' in liaison.

examples.sentence: Cette tâche est impossible pour moi.
examples.translation: This task is impossible for me.

examples.sentence: Il est impossible d'ouvrir cette porte sans clé.
examples.translation: It is impossible to open this door without a key. (Liaison)

examples.sentence: Si cela était impossible, nous chercherions une autre idée.
examples.translation: If that were impossible, we would look for another idea.

examples.sentence: Cette mission a été jugée impossible par l'expert.
examples.translation: This mission was judged impossible by the expert.

entries.intro: Refers to tasks requiring little effort (simple/easy), or single (opposite of double). Opposite of 'complexe' (#365).
entries.usage: Inflects: simple (m/f), simples (pl). Precedes or follows the noun depending on meaning (un simple soldat - a mere soldier).

examples.sentence: C'est une règle très simple.
examples.translation: This is a very simple rule.

examples.sentence: Il est simple de faire ce gâteau.
examples.translation: It is simple to make this cake. (Impersonal)

examples.sentence: Si la question était simple, je répondrais vite.
examples.translation: If the question were simple, I would reply fast.

examples.sentence: Le problème a été résolu de manière simple.
examples.translation: The problem was solved in a simple manner.

entries.intro: Refers to complicated matters. Opposite of 'simple' (#364). As a noun, a psychological or industrial complex.
entries.usage: Inflects: complexe (m/f), complexes (pl). Placed after the noun.

examples.sentence: Cette machine est très complexe.
examples.translation: This machine is very complex.

examples.sentence: Il a résolu un problème complexe.
examples.translation: He solved a complex problem.

examples.sentence: Si le sujet était complexe, nous ferions une étude.
examples.translation: If the topic were complex, we would do a study.

examples.sentence: Ce dossier complexe est traité par l'avocat.
examples.translation: This complex file is handled by the lawyer.

entries.intro: Refers to clear image/sound, neat clean cut, or net value (salary after taxes). Opposite of 'brut' (gross) or 'flou' (blurry).
entries.usage: Inflects: net (m), nette (f), nets (m pl), nettes (f pl). Pronounced /nɛt/.

examples.sentence: Le son de la radio est très net.
examples.translation: The radio sound is very clear.

examples.sentence: Je perçois un salaire net de deux mille euros.
examples.translation: I receive a net salary of two thousand euros.

examples.sentence: Si l'image était nette, nous verrions les détails.
examples.translation: If the image were clear (sharp), we would see the details.

examples.sentence: La coupure nette a été faite par les ciseaux.
examples.translation: The neat cut was made by the scissors.

entries.intro: Refers to lack of light (dark), gloomy mood, or dim colors. Opposite of 'clair' (light/clear) or 'lumineux' (bright).
entries.usage: Inflects: sombre (m/f), sombres (pl). Placed after the noun.

examples.sentence: La forêt est sombre et mystérieuse.
examples.translation: The forest is dark and mysterious.

examples.sentence: Il a des pensées sombres ce soir.
examples.translation: He has gloomy thoughts tonight.

examples.sentence: Si la chambre était sombre, j'allumerais la lumière.
examples.translation: If the room were dark, I would turn on the light.

examples.sentence: Le tableau sombre a été restauré par l'expert.
examples.translation: The dark painting was restored by the expert.

entries.intro: Refers to extremely high temperature (burning hot / scalding) or topical issues. Opposite of 'glacé' (#369) and related to 'chaud' (Chunk 3).
entries.usage: Inflects: brûlant (m), brûlante (f), brûlants (m pl), brûlantes (f pl). Derived from verb 'brûler'.

examples.sentence: Le thé brûlant m'a brûlé la langue.
examples.translation: The scalding hot tea burned my tongue.

examples.sentence: C'est un sujet d'actualité brûlant.
examples.translation: This is a burning topical issue.

examples.sentence: Si le soleil était brûlant, nous resterions à l'ombre.
examples.translation: If the sun were burning hot, we would stay in the shade.

examples.sentence: Le sable brûlant a été évité par les marcheurs.
examples.translation: The burning sand was avoided by the walkers.

entries.intro: Refers to freezing temperature (icy cold / frozen) or glazed food (e.g. marron glacé). Opposite of 'brûlant' (#368) and related to 'froid' (Chunk 3).
entries.usage: Inflects: glacé (m), glacée (f), glacés (m pl), glacées (f pl). Derived from noun 'glace' (ice) / verb 'glacer'.

examples.sentence: Je bois de l'eau glacée en été.
examples.translation: I drink icy cold water in summer.

examples.sentence: Le vent glacé souffle du nord.
examples.translation: The icy wind blows from the north.

examples.sentence: Si le lac était glacé, nous ferions du patinage.
examples.translation: If the lake were frozen, we would go ice skating.

examples.sentence: Le gâteau glacé a été préparé pour l'anniversaire.
examples.translation: The ice cream cake was prepared for the birthday.

entries.intro: Expresses certainty (sure) or safety (safe/secure). Related to adverb 'bien sûr' (Chunk 2) and adjective 'tranquille' (#371).
entries.usage: Inflects: sûr (m), sûre (f), sûrs (m pl), sûres (f pl). Note the accent circonflexe (distinguishes from preposition 'sur').

examples.sentence: Je suis sûr de mon choix.
examples.translation: I am sure of my choice.

examples.sentence: C'est un endroit sûr pour camper.
examples.translation: This is a safe place to camp.

examples.sentence: Si la méthode était sûre, nous l'adopterions.
examples.translation: If the method were safe, we would adopt it.

examples.sentence: Le coffre-fort a été rendu sûr par le serrurier.
examples.translation: The safe was made secure by the locksmith.

entries.intro: Refers to peaceful quiet state or calm personality. Opposite of 'bruyant' (noisy). Related to 'sûr' (#370) and 'doucement' (#382).
entries.usage: Inflects: tranquille (m/f), tranquilles (pl). Double 'l' is pronounced /l/ (irregular, not /j/).

examples.sentence: C'est un quartier très tranquille.
examples.translation: This is a very quiet neighborhood.

examples.sentence: Laissez-moi tranquille, s'il vous plaît.
examples.translation: Leave me alone (quiet), please.

examples.sentence: Si la campagne était tranquille, j'y habiterais.
examples.translation: If the country were quiet, I would live there.

examples.sentence: Le sommeil tranquille a été perturbé par l'orage. (Derived passive context)
examples.translation: Quiet sleep was disturbed by the storm.

entries.intro: Refers to being satisfied or happy with something. Opposite of 'fâché' (#373) and related to 'heureux' (Chunk 3).
entries.usage: Inflects: content (m), contente (f), contents (m pl), contentes (f pl). Final -t is silent in masculine.

examples.sentence: Je suis content de ton travail.
examples.translation: I am pleased with your work.

examples.sentence: Elle est contente de sa nouvelle maison.
examples.translation: She is happy with her new house.

examples.sentence: Si tu venais à la fête, je serais très content.
examples.translation: If you came to the party, I would be very glad.

examples.sentence: Le directeur a été rendu content par nos résultats. (Derived passive context)
examples.translation: The director was made pleased by our results.

entries.intro: Refers to being angry with someone (fâché contre quelqu'un), or sorry in formal usage (je suis fâché de...). Opposite of 'content' (#372).
entries.usage: Inflects: fâché (m), fâchée (f), fâchés (m pl), fâchées (f pl). Accent circonflexe on 'a'.

examples.sentence: Il est fâché contre son ami.
examples.translation: He is angry with his friend.

examples.sentence: Elle a l'air fâchée aujourd'hui.
examples.translation: She looks angry today.

examples.sentence: Si je perdais tes clés, tu serais fâché.
examples.translation: If I lost your keys, you would be angry.

examples.sentence: Le client fâché a été calmé par le gérant.
examples.translation: The angry customer was calmed by the manager.

entries.intro: Meaning funny/humorous, or strange/peculiar ('un drôle de...'). Opposite of 'sérieux' (serious) or related to 'rire' (#317).
entries.usage: Inflects: drôle (m/f), drôles (pl). Accent circonflexe on 'o'.

examples.sentence: C'est une histoire très drôle.
examples.translation: This is a very funny story.

examples.sentence: Il a une drôle de voix.
examples.translation: He has a strange voice. (Strange usage)

examples.sentence: Si tu racontais une blague, ce serait drôle.
examples.translation: If you told a joke, it would be funny.

examples.sentence: Cet incident drôle a été raconté par mon frère.
examples.translation: This funny incident was told by my brother.

entries.intro: Refers to goods/services obtained without payment (free of charge), or actions without reason (gratuitous). Opposite of 'payant' (paying).
entries.usage: Inflects: gratuit (m), gratuite (f), gratuits (m pl), gratuites (f pl). Final -t is silent in masculine.

examples.sentence: L'entrée du musée est gratuite le dimanche.
examples.translation: Museum entry is free on Sundays.

examples.sentence: Ce service est entièrement gratuit.
examples.translation: This service is entirely free.

examples.sentence: Si le concert était gratuit, j'irais avec plaisir.
examples.translation: If the concert were free, I would go with pleasure.

examples.sentence: L'accès gratuit a été accordé aux étudiants.
examples.translation: Free access was granted to students.

entries.intro: Refers to containing nothing (empty). Opposite of 'plein' (#377). As a noun, a physical vacuum or empty space.
entries.usage: Inflects: vide (m/f), vides (pl). Placed after the noun.

examples.sentence: La boîte sur la table est vide.
examples.translation: The box on the table is empty.

examples.sentence: Il y a un grand vide dans cette pièce.
examples.translation: There is a large empty space in this room. (Noun usage)

examples.sentence: Si ma valise était vide, je la remplirais.
examples.translation: If my suitcase were empty, I would fill it.

examples.sentence: La bouteille vide a été jetée à la poubelle.
examples.translation: The empty bottle was thrown in the trash.

entries.intro: Refers to containing as much as possible (full), or mid/middle ('en plein air' - outdoors). Opposite of 'vide' (#376).
entries.usage: Inflects: plein (m), pleine (f), pleins (m pl), pleines (f pl). Preposition 'plein de' means 'a lot of / plenty'.

examples.sentence: Le verre est plein d'eau.
examples.translation: The glass is full of water.

examples.sentence: Il y a plein de gens dans la rue.
examples.translation: There are plenty of people in the street. (Prepositional usage)

examples.sentence: Si le réservoir était plein, nous partirions loin.
examples.translation: If the tank were full, we would travel far.

examples.sentence: Le sac plein a été porté par le facteur.
examples.translation: The full bag was carried by the postman.

entries.intro: Refers to low weight (lightweight), mild taste/breeze, or gentle behavior. Opposite of 'lourd' (#379) and related to 'doux' (Chunk 3).
entries.usage: Inflects: léger (m), légère (f), légers (m pl), légères (f pl). Accent grave on e in feminine.

examples.sentence: Cette veste est très légère.
examples.translation: This jacket is very light (weight).

examples.sentence: Un vent léger souffle ce matin.
examples.translation: A mild breeze is blowing this morning.

examples.sentence: Si le bagage était léger, je le porterais à pied.
examples.translation: If the luggage were light, I would carry it on foot.

examples.sentence: Le repas léger a été préparé pour le malade.
examples.translation: The light meal was prepared for the sick person.

entries.intro: Refers to high weight (heavy) or slow massive movement. Opposite of 'léger' (#378) and related to 'dur' (Chunk 3).
entries.usage: Inflects: lourd (m), lourde (f), lourds (m pl), lourdes (f pl). Final -d is silent in masculine.

examples.sentence: Ce paquet est trop lourd pour moi.
examples.translation: This package is too heavy for me.

examples.sentence: Il porte une lourde responsabilité.
examples.translation: He carries a heavy responsibility. (Abstract)

examples.sentence: Si le fauteuil était lourd, nous le déplacerions à deux.
examples.translation: If the armchair were heavy, we would move it together.

examples.sentence: Le fardeau lourd a été porté par l'âne.
examples.translation: The heavy burden was carried by the donkey.

entries.intro: Refers to lack of moisture (dry) or blunt personality/answers. Opposite of 'mouillé' (wet) or 'humide' (damp).
entries.usage: Inflects: sec (m), sèche (f), secs (m pl), sèches (f pl). Irregular feminine: sèche.

examples.sentence: Le linge est sec maintenant.
examples.translation: The laundry is dry now.

examples.sentence: Il m'a fait une réponse sèche.
examples.translation: He gave me a blunt answer. (Blunt usage)

examples.sentence: Si le climat était sec, nous aurions chaud.
examples.translation: If the climate were dry, we would feel hot. (Liaison)

examples.sentence: Le bois sec a été brûlé dans la cheminée.
examples.translation: The dry wood was burned in the fireplace.

entries.intro: Adverb of speed indicating rapid movement or quick completion. Related to adjective 'rapide' (Chunk 3) and opposite 'doucement' (#382).
entries.usage: Invariable. Formed by feminine adjective 'rapide' + suffix '-ment'.

examples.sentence: Le train roule rapidement vers Paris.
examples.translation: The train runs rapidly towards Paris.

examples.sentence: Il finit rapidement son travail.
examples.translation: He finishes his work quickly.

examples.sentence: Si tu lisais rapidement, tu finirais ce livre ce soir.
examples.translation: If you read quickly, you would finish this book tonight.

examples.sentence: Le problème a été résolu rapidement par l'équipe.
examples.translation: The problem was solved rapidly by the team.

entries.intro: Adverb indicating gentle touch (gently), soft sound (softly), or low speed (slowly). Opposite of 'rapidement' (#381) and related to 'tranquille' (#371).
entries.usage: Invariable. Formed by feminine adjective 'douce' + '-ment'.

examples.sentence: Parlez doucement, le bébé dort.
examples.translation: Speak softly, the baby is sleeping.

examples.sentence: Elle ferme doucement la porte.
examples.translation: She gently closes the door.

examples.sentence: Si tu marchais doucement, tu n'éveillerais personne.
examples.translation: If you walked slowly (softly), you wouldn't wake anyone.

examples.sentence: La vérité a été doucement révélée à sa mère.
examples.translation: The truth was gently revealed to his/her mother.

entries.intro: Adverb of frequency indicating occasional actions. Related to 'parfois' (Chunk 3) and opposite 'toujours' (Chunk 1).
entries.usage: Invariable. Written as a single word.

examples.sentence: Il va quelquefois au théâtre le soir.
examples.translation: He sometimes goes to the theater in the evening.

examples.sentence: Quelquefois, la vie réserve de belles surprises.
examples.translation: Sometimes, life offers beautiful surprises.

examples.sentence: Si tu me rendais visite quelquefois, je serais ravi.
examples.translation: If you visited me sometimes, I would be delighted.

examples.sentence: Cette erreur est quelquefois commise par les débutants.
examples.translation: This error is sometimes made by beginners.

entries.intro: Adverb of time indicating sudden unexpected actions. Related to 'soudainement' and adjective 'soudain'.
entries.usage: Invariable adverb, or inflected adjective (soudain / soudaine).

examples.sentence: Soudain, un grand bruit s'est fait entendre.
examples.translation: Suddenly, a loud noise was heard. (Liaison)

examples.sentence: La pluie a commencé de façon soudaine.
examples.translation: The rain started in a sudden manner. (Adjective usage)

examples.sentence: Si un orage éclatait soudain, nous serions trempés.
examples.translation: If a storm broke out suddenly, we would be soaked.

examples.sentence: Le départ soudain a été décidé par le chef.
examples.translation: The sudden departure was decided by the boss. (Adjective passive context)

entries.intro: Indicates a state extremely close to completion. Colloquial equivalent of 'presque' (Chunk 3) and related to 'environ' (Chunk 3).
entries.usage: Invariable. Suffix '-ment'.

examples.sentence: J'ai quasiment fini mon travail.
examples.translation: I have almost finished my work.

examples.sentence: Il n'y a quasiment personne dans la rue.
examples.translation: There is virtually nobody in the street.

examples.sentence: Si la bouteille était quasiment vide, je la jetterais.
examples.translation: If the bottle were nearly empty, I would throw it away.

examples.sentence: La victoire a été quasiment acquise à la mi-temps.
examples.translation: The victory was virtually secured at halftime. (Liaison)

entries.intro: Adverb of degree highlighting a feature. Equivalent of 'surtout' (Chunk 3) and related to 'uniquement' (#397).
entries.usage: Invariable. Suffix '-ment'.

examples.sentence: J'aime les fruits, particulièrement les cerises.
examples.translation: I like fruits, particularly cherries.

examples.sentence: Ce projet est particulièrement difficile.
examples.translation: This project is particularly difficult.

examples.sentence: Si le vent soufflait particulièrement fort, nous fermerions les volets.
examples.translation: If the wind blew particularly hard, we would close the shutters.

examples.sentence: Cette règle est particulièrement suivie par le personnel.
examples.translation: This rule is particularly followed by the staff.

entries.intro: Denotes sufficiency. Equivalent of 'assez' (Chunk 3) and related to 'tellement' (#389).
entries.usage: Invariable. Requires 'de' before nouns (e.g. suffisamment de pain). Requires spelling double -m.

examples.sentence: J'ai suffisamment mangé ce soir.
examples.translation: I have eaten sufficiently tonight.

examples.sentence: Il y a suffisamment de chaises dans la salle.
examples.translation: There are enough chairs in the hall.

examples.sentence: Si j'avais suffisamment d'argent, j'achèterais cette maison.
examples.translation: If I had enough money, I would buy this house. (Liaison)

examples.sentence: Ce point a été suffisamment débattu par l'assemblée.
examples.translation: This point was sufficiently debated by the assembly.

entries.intro: Negative adverb meaning hardly, scarcely, or not much. Always paired with 'ne' (ne... guère).
entries.usage: Invariable. Goes around the conjugated verb: je n'ai guère de temps.

examples.sentence: Il n'y a guère de doute sur son innocence.
examples.translation: There is hardly any doubt about his innocence.

examples.sentence: Je ne lis guère ces journaux.
examples.translation: I hardly read these newspapers.

examples.sentence: Si tu ne travaillais guère, tu échouerais.
examples.translation: If you worked hardly at all, you would fail.

examples.sentence: Cette ancienne coutume n'est guère pratiquée aujourd'hui.
examples.translation: This ancient custom is hardly practiced today.

entries.intro: Adverb of intensity expressing large degree/quantity, often leading to consequence ('tellement... que' - so... that). Related to 'beaucoup' (Chunk 3).
entries.usage: Invariable. Requires 'de' before nouns (e.g. tellement de choses).

examples.sentence: J'aime tellement ce paysage.
examples.translation: I like this scenery so much.

examples.sentence: Il y a tellement de bruit que je ne dors pas.
examples.translation: There is so much noise that I cannot sleep.

examples.sentence: Si tu parlais tellement fort, tout le monde t'entendrait.
examples.translation: If you spoke so loud, everyone would hear you. (Liaison)

examples.sentence: Ce secret a été tellement gardé qu'il a été oublié.
examples.translation: This secret was kept so much that it was forgotten.

entries.intro: Denotes position surrounding something. Cross-referenced with 'autour de' (around).
entries.usage: Requires 'de' when acting as preposition (autour de la table). Invariable.

examples.sentence: La terre tourne autour du soleil.
examples.translation: The earth rotates around the sun.

examples.sentence: Les enfants courent autour de la maison.
examples.translation: The children are running around the house.

examples.sentence: Si nous marchions autour du lac, nous verrions les oiseaux.
examples.translation: If we walked around the lake, we would see the birds. (Liaison)

examples.sentence: Le château a été construit autour de la colline.
examples.translation: The castle was built around the hill.

entries.intro: Denotes position lower than something. Opposite of 'dessus' (#392) and related to 'sous'.
entries.usage: Invariable adverb/preposition. Requires 'en dessous de' as complex preposition.

examples.sentence: Regarde dessous pour voir le jouet.
examples.translation: Look underneath to see the toy.

examples.sentence: La clé est cachée là-dessous.
examples.translation: The key is hidden under there.

examples.sentence: Si la boîte était dessous, je la prendrais.
examples.translation: If the box were underneath, I would take it.

examples.sentence: Le dessous de la table a été nettoyé.
examples.translation: The underside of the table was cleaned. (Noun usage)

entries.intro: Denotes position higher than or on top of something. Opposite of 'dessous' (#391) and related to 'sur'.
entries.usage: Invariable adverb/preposition. Requires 'au-dessus de' as complex preposition.

examples.sentence: Le livre est posé dessus.
examples.translation: The book is placed on top of it.

examples.sentence: Passez par-dessus la barrière.
examples.translation: Go over (above) the barrier. (Prepositional context)

examples.sentence: Si le chat sautait dessus, il casserait le pot.
examples.translation: If the cat jumped on top of it, it would break the pot.

examples.sentence: Le dessus de la boîte a été peint en bleu.
examples.translation: The top of the box was painted blue. (Noun usage)

entries.intro: Denotes a different location (elsewhere). 'D'ailleurs' (besides / by the way).
entries.usage: Invariable. Final -s is silent. Requires 'd'' in compound.

examples.sentence: Je ne trouve pas mes clés, elles sont ailleurs.
examples.translation: I cannot find my keys, they are somewhere else. (Liaison)

examples.sentence: Allons ailleurs, il y a trop de bruit ici.
examples.translation: Let's go elsewhere, there is too much noise here.

examples.sentence: Si le restaurant était complet, nous mangerions ailleurs.
examples.translation: If the restaurant were full, we would eat elsewhere.

examples.sentence: Le coupable a été arrêté ailleurs. (Derived passive context)
examples.translation: The culprit was arrested elsewhere.

entries.intro: Adverb of space meaning in all locations. Related to 'ailleurs' (#393) and opposite 'nulle part' (nowhere).
entries.usage: Invariable. Final -t is silent.

examples.sentence: Il y a des fleurs partout dans le jardin.
examples.translation: There are flowers everywhere in the garden.

examples.sentence: Je t'ai cherché partout.
examples.translation: I looked for you everywhere.

examples.sentence: Si la pluie tombait partout, nous serions tous mouillés.
examples.translation: If the rain fell everywhere, we would all be wet.

examples.sentence: Cette chanson est entendue partout ce mois-ci.
examples.translation: This song is heard everywhere this month.

entries.intro: Expresses preference (rather/instead) or moderate intensity (quite/rather).
entries.usage: Invariable. Do not confuse with 'plus tôt' (earlier - #400). Final -t is silent.

examples.sentence: Je préfère prendre le thé plutôt que le café.
examples.translation: I prefer to have tea rather than coffee. (Preference)

examples.sentence: Ce travail est plutôt difficile.
examples.translation: This work is quite (rather) difficult.

examples.sentence: Si tu venais plutôt ce soir, nous dînerions ensemble. (Wait, here the spelling 'plutôt' means rather, but in context 'sooner' is 'plus tôt').
examples.translation: If you came instead tonight, we would dine together. (Instead usage)

examples.sentence: La première option a été plutôt choisie par le comité.
examples.translation: The first option was rather chosen by the committee. (Preference passive)

entries.intro: Expresses opposition or concession. Equivalents: yet, however, nevertheless.
entries.usage: Invariable. Final -t is silent.

examples.sentence: Il travaille beaucoup, pourtant il échoue.
examples.translation: He works hard, yet he fails.

examples.sentence: C'est difficile, et pourtant c'est possible.
examples.translation: It is difficult, and yet it is possible. (Liaison)

examples.sentence: Si tu connaissais la règle, pourtant tu ferais l'erreur.
examples.translation: If you knew the rule, yet you would make the mistake. (Opposition context)

examples.sentence: L'erreur a été pourtant signalée par le système.
examples.translation: The error was nevertheless flagged by the system.

entries.intro: Adverb of exclusivity (only/solely). Related to 'seul' (Chunk 3) and 'particulièrement' (#386).
entries.usage: Invariable. Suffix '-ment'.

examples.sentence: Ce service est réservé uniquement aux membres.
examples.translation: This service is reserved only for members.

examples.sentence: Il pense uniquement à son travail.
examples.translation: He thinks solely about his work.

examples.sentence: Si tu mangeais uniquement des fruits, tu serais en forme.
examples.translation: If you ate only fruits, you would be fit. (Liaison)

examples.sentence: Ce droit a été accordé uniquement aux citoyens.
examples.translation: This right was granted solely to citizens.

entries.intro: Expresses probability or certainty (certainly/surely). Related to adjective 'certain' (#361).
entries.usage: Invariable. Suffix '-ment'. In modern speech, it can mean 'probably' contextually.

examples.sentence: Il viendra certainement demain matin.
examples.translation: He will certainly come tomorrow morning.

examples.sentence: C'est certainement la meilleure solution.
examples.translation: This is certainly the best solution. (Liaison)

examples.sentence: Si tu demandais de l'aide, tu recevrais certainement du soutien.
examples.translation: If you asked for help, you would certainly receive support. (Liaison)

examples.sentence: La proposition sera certainement acceptée par le maire.
examples.translation: The proposal will certainly be accepted by the mayor.

entries.intro: Late in time. Opposite of 'tôt' (#400) and related to 'soirée' (#330).
entries.usage: Invariable adverb. Final -d is silent, pronounced /t/ in liaison (tard ou tôt). 'Plus tard' (later).

examples.sentence: Il arrive toujours en retard au travail. (Compound 'en retard' - late)
examples.translation: He always arrives late at work.

examples.sentence: Il se fait tard, je dois partir.
examples.translation: It is getting late, I must leave.

examples.sentence: Si tu rentrais plus tard, la porte serait fermée.
examples.translation: If you came back later, the door would be closed.

examples.sentence: La décision tardive a été prise trop tard. (Derived passive context)
examples.translation: The late decision was taken too late.

entries.intro: Early in time, or soon. Opposite of 'tard' (#399) and related to 'bientôt' (Chunk 3).
entries.usage: Invariable. Accent circonflexe on 'o'. Final -t is silent. 'Le plus tôt possible' (as soon as possible).

examples.sentence: Je me lève tôt le matin pour travailler.
examples.translation: I get up early in the morning to work.

examples.sentence: Il est trop tôt pour partir.
examples.translation: It is too early to leave. (Liaison)

examples.sentence: Si nous partions tôt, nous éviterions les bouchons.
examples.translation: If we left early, we would avoid traffic jams.

examples.sentence: Le blé a été récolté tôt cette année.
examples.translation: The wheat was harvested early this year.
